mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and remains above this threshold for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy suppresses corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals inflationary pressure that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: In UNRATE < 3.5% periods, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC for joint condition falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly INDPRO increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals residential sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 5.0% periods, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC for joint condition falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.
